stem: What is the output of the following code?

options.rationale: This adds every odd number up to 9, ignoring the break.
This adds 7 as well, but the loop breaks before 7 is added.
This stops after the first two odd numbers; 5 is still added.
Only 1, 3 and 5 are added before 7 triggers the break.

explanation: continue skips the rest of the loop body for even numbers. The odd numbers 1, 3 and 5 are added. When n is 7, the condition n > 6 is true and break ends the loop before 7 is added, so the total is 1 + 3 + 5 = 9.
